name: Friends And Death
overview: Scripture reveals that in the face of death and sorrow, God is a steadfast friend who provides strength, comfort, and healing to the brokenhearted. The Lord commands His people to be courageous and unafraid, assuring them of His constant presence (Joshua 1:9). Even when walking through the darkest valleys, believers need not fear evil because God’s rod and staff bring comfort (Psalms 23:4). He draws near to those with contrite spirits, healing their wounds and offering Himself as an eternal strength and portion (Psalms 34:18; 73:26; 147:3). Moreover, God’s heart is moved with compassion, desiring life rather than death for the sinner and calling for repentance and renewed life (Ezekiel 18:32).
